description: This file defines the Account entity class used for persistence in an Android app. It includes fields such as URL, username, account name, capabilities, and visual styling attributes. It also provides constructors, getters/setters, and overrides for equals/hashCode/toString.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Entity class representing user account information, including credentials, capabilities, and display settings for persistence in the app.

methods.name: setCapabilities
methods.description: Sets the capabilities-related fields based on a Capabilities object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the account.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the account.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Returns the account's URL.

methods.name: getAvatarUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the URL for the account's avatar image.

methods.name: setUrl
methods.description: Sets the account's URL.

methods.name: getUserName
methods.description: Returns the username associated with the account.

methods.name: setUserName
methods.description: Sets the username for the account.

methods.name: getAccountName
methods.description: Returns the account display name.

methods.name: setAccountName
methods.description: Sets the account display name.

methods.name: getETag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for versioning or caching.

methods.name: setETag
methods.description: Sets the entity tag.

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Returns the last modified time as a Calendar object.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the last modified time.

methods.name: getApiVersion
methods.description: Returns the API version string.

methods.name: setApiVersion
methods.description: Sets the API version.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with the account.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the account's color.

methods.name: getTextColor
methods.description: Returns the text color for display.

methods.name: setTextColor
methods.description: Sets the text color.

methods.name: getCapabilitiesETag
methods.description: Returns the ETag for capabilities.

methods.name: setCapabilitiesETag
methods.description: Sets the capabilities ETag.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the account.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name.

methods.name: isDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Checks if direct editing is available.

methods.name: setDirectEditingAvailable
methods.description: Sets the status of direct editing availability.
